brief.from_parent: The parent validated complete quartic interactions and fixed ten-mode one-loop two-point coefficients at source a078aca in 111.56 seconds. This child extends the required higher-order ingredients, not the two-point frequency grid.
brief.healthy: All exact legacy comparisons vanish. Independent 90-digit finite-metric coefficients and Richardson refinements agree below 1e-12 scaled error. Green identities vanish exactly; separately evaluated analytic derivatives satisfy their declared numerical bounds, and independent heat-moment quadrature converges. The Cartesian Green inverse also reproduces independent radial multipole values, exact Fourier Coulomb normalization and the already derived pure-momentum sixth-order coefficient with a bounded omitted tail.

These checks do not evaluate the complete H5/H6 Hamiltonian, gravitational four-point loop, or a large-N limit.
brief.worth_a_flag: Any exact identity, independently extracted coefficient, Green residual, moment convergence, or declared tail check fails. A traceback or exceeded 1800-second wall limit ends this bounded run. Do not call ingredient validation a four-graviton result.
brief.decided: One local Python standard-library process, no GPU or remote spend. New higher-order stages are untimed. The previous numerical sources and failed coarse-quadrature run stay immutable.
